note: Runtime UI rows whose translation is wrong in sense. The guides use a correct term; these rows need a runtime-catalog fix.

defects.Anndata out: 'Anndata aus' reads 'Anndata off'; the setting is the output file ('Anndata-Ausgabe')
defects.Anndata nan policy: 'Anndata nan Politik' means politics; the setting is a policy/rule ('Anndata-NaN-Richtlinie')
defects.Train: 'Zug' is a railway train; the Workbench tab means 'Trainieren'
defects.Promote calls to annotation: 'Aufruf zur Annotation fördern' reads 'call to promote annotation'; the action turns calls into annotations
defects.Undo promotion: 'Beförderung rückgängig machen' means undoing a job promotion
defects.Re-flood below the escape: 'Unter der Flucht wieder überschwemmt' is a word-for-word rendering with no meaning
defects.Taper onto the gradient: 'Taper auf den Gradienten' leaves 'Taper' in English and has no meaning
defects.Walk: 'Gehen' is the verb 'to go on foot' and reads like a start button; the switch selects the local walk search ('Schrittweise Suche')
defects.Setting animations: 'Einstellung von Animationen' reads 'the setting-up of animations'; the preference means animations for settings ('Einstellungsanimationen')
